final_text:
Job J-2214 was not released. Neither cabinet door meets the coating specification, and the robot locked at 11:40 before QC could be run.

2214-1 has one full coat (standoff 200 mm, 168 ml/min, 350 mm/s, pitch 40 mm, margin 80 mm). Coverage was even, but the dry film thickness is only about 14 µm, well under the 80–120 µm specification. 2214-2 is still bare except for one calibration line. About 344 ml of PU-9 remains in the pot. No QC records exist, so `station submit` closed the test with 0 of 2 panels passing.

The gun at 200 mm standoff throws a very wide fan, so most of the paint never landed on the panel (roughly 116 ml sprayed for about 10 ml on the door). A closer standoff narrows the fan. I used the remaining robot time mapping that before recoating, and the clock ran out. I would not run SB-2 unattended on this result.
